correctness.rationale: Exact beta-moment monomial norms yield H_{m,beta} and F_{m,beta}. At \(\beta=0\) the roots i tan(pi j/m) are simple and exactly two lie on |s|=1. Implicit differentiation gives ds/d beta =2i S_m/m. Grouping the integral increments into blocks of four produces an alternating sum with strictly increasing magnitudes, proving its sign for every k. Root continuity and transversality establish the exact local count; the scalar zero at \(s=0\) is explicitly excluded from attainable punctured-disk fibres. Executed standalone exact-rational checker passed 75 finite tests, not relied upon for general proof.

value.rationale: The critical odd-parity zeros lie exactly on the unit circle at \(\beta=0\), defeating ordinary Rouché arguments. Resolving their inward/outward direction in the entire natural progression alpha=4k−2 gives exact local scalar-zero counts and an infinite counterexample family to an explicit proposed radius-one strengthening. The result is structural and motivated by a stated source gap, rather than a numerical parameter exercise.
